title: Restore Drills Are Mandatory
summary: A backup is an intention until a restore drill proves it. The drill restores into a disposable database, checks row counts, runs critical queries, records duration, and fails loudly on mismatch. Checksums and logs help validate the artifact and recovery process.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Restore Drills Are Mandatory.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
